# PlanMyProject - Copilot & Codex Instructions

These instructions are specific to this repository. Follow them for any task related to build, test, versioning, packaging, release notes, or Marketplace publishing.

## Scope

- Extension: `Plan My Project`
- Package name: `plan-my-project`
- Publisher: `aypande`
- Manifest: `package.json`
- Extension entrypoint: `main: ./out/extension.js`

## Repository Truths (Do Not Assume Generic Templates)

- Source files live in `src/`.
- Tests live in `test/*.test.ts` and compile to `out-test/test/*.test.js`.
- Test runtime is Node's built-in test runner (`node --test`) with `NODE_PATH=./test/shims`.
- Build status in `README.md` is auto-generated by `scripts/update-readme-build-status.js`.
- Packaging/publishing is done with `@vscode/vsce` via npm scripts.
- This repo does not define a lint script. Do not invent one.

## Canonical npm Scripts

Always use these scripts from `package.json` unless the user explicitly asks otherwise:

```bash
npm run compile        # tsc -p ./
npm test               # test:build + node --test out-test/test/**/*.test.js
npm run test:coverage  # same tests with --experimental-test-coverage
npm run build          # compile + test coverage + README build-status refresh
npm run verify         # alias of build
npm run package        # npx @vscode/vsce package --no-yarn --no-dependencies
npm run publish:vsce   # npx @vscode/vsce publish --no-yarn --no-dependencies
```

## Hard Guardrails

1. Never publish if `npm run build` or `npm test` fails.
2. Never publish without updating `CHANGELOG.md`.
3. Never run `npm version major` without explicit user confirmation.
4. Always use `npm version <patch|minor|major> --no-git-tag-version`.
5. Never manually edit compiled output in `out/` or `out-test/`.
6. Never commit secrets or credentials (`VSCE_PAT`, `.env`, tokens, keys).
7. Always inspect package contents before publish with `vsce ls`.

## Build and Test Workflow

When asked to build, verify, or prepare a release:

1. Run `npm run compile`.
2. Run `npm test`.
3. Run `npm run build` to refresh README build status block.
4. Stop immediately and report failures if any command returns non-zero.

Expected success criteria:

- `out/extension.js` exists and matches `package.json.main`.
- All tests pass.
- README build-status block remains valid (auto-updated by build script).

## Changelog and Versioning Workflow

When asked to bump/release:

1. Update `CHANGELOG.md` under `## [Unreleased]` with user-facing entries.
2. Determine bump type from changes:
   - `patch`: fixes only
   - `minor`: backward-compatible features
   - `major`: breaking changes (needs explicit confirmation)
3. Run one command:
   - `npm version patch --no-git-tag-version`
   - `npm version minor --no-git-tag-version`
   - `npm version major --no-git-tag-version`
4. Move release notes from `Unreleased` into `## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD`.
5. Recreate a fresh empty `## [Unreleased]` section at top.
6. Update the README release line: `Current release: vX.Y.Z`.
7. Run `npm run build` again so status metadata is fresh after release edits.

Files that must stay in sync for a release:

- `package.json`
- `package-lock.json`
- `CHANGELOG.md`
- `README.md` (release line and build-status block)

## Publishing Workflow (Marketplace)

Run in this exact order:

1. Verify prereqs:
   - `VSCE_PAT` is available in environment
   - Logged in publisher account (`npx @vscode/vsce login aypande`) when needed
   - `package.json` has correct `publisher`, `version`, `repository`, `license`, `icon`
   - `.vscodeignore` excludes source/tests/secrets from package
2. Run final verification:
   - `npm run build`
   - `npm test`
3. Package:
   - `npm run package`
   - Artifact should be `plan-my-project-<version>.vsix`
4. Audit package contents:
   - `npx @vscode/vsce ls --no-yarn --no-dependencies`
5. Publish:
   - `npm run publish:vsce`
6. Create VCS release metadata:
   - `git add package.json package-lock.json CHANGELOG.md README.md`
   - `git commit -m "chore: release vX.Y.Z"`
   - `git tag vX.Y.Z`
7. Push commit and tag after successful publish:
   - `git push origin <branch>`
   - `git push origin vX.Y.Z`

## Release Checklist

```text
[ ] CHANGELOG updated under Unreleased
[ ] Version bumped with --no-git-tag-version
[ ] README "Current release" updated
[ ] npm run build passes
[ ] npm test passes
[ ] VSIX packaged successfully
[ ] vsce ls reviewed for unexpected files
[ ] Marketplace publish completed
[ ] release commit created
[ ] git tag vX.Y.Z created and pushed
```
